call.note: ett samtal, samtalet, samtal (pl.). Established throughout existing translations.

join a call.note: Existing majority uses 'anslut' for joining calls (button 'Anslut'); reserve 'gå med' for channels/teams.

end a call.note: Host action: 'Avsluta samtalet för alla'. Distinct from 'lämna' (leave).

make host.note: Existing rendering in both webapp and mobile.

host controls.note: Existing rendering; the compact 'värdkontroller' is an alternative if space is tight.

recording.note: en inspelning, inspelningar. Record call = 'spela in samtal'.

transcription.note: Majority rendering (13 vs 1 for 'transkription'). Call transcriptions = 'samtalstranskriberingar'.

live captions.note: Established in existing Calls admin strings.

raise hand.note: Button: 'Räck upp handen'; '{name} räckte upp handen'.

screen share.note: Noun: 'skärmdelning'. Verb: 'dela skärmen' (Stop screen share = 'Sluta dela skärmen'; Start presenting = 'Börja presentera').

mute.note: Existing Calls strings consistently use the anglicism 'mjuta' ('Mjuta', 'mjutad'). Keep for consistency; 'stäng av mikrofonen' is the more standard Swedish phrasing if a cleanup is ever coordinated.

unmute.note: Existing variants: 'Avmjuta' (mobile), 'Ljud på', 'Avtysta'. Use 'avmjuta' to pair with 'mjuta'.

call ringing.note: Existing writes 'samtals-signal'/'ringsignaler'; prefer the solid compound 'samtalssignal'. Enable call ringing = 'Aktivera samtalssignal'.

pop out.note: No existing sv translation for the widget action; use this descriptive phrase.

speaker view.note: No existing sv translation; matches Teams/Zoom Swedish conventions. Switch to speaker view = 'Byt till talarvy'.

grid view.note: No existing sv translation. Switch to grid view = 'Byt till rutnätsvy'.

blur background.note: No existing sv translation; matches Teams Swedish convention.

meeting summary.note: Existing: 'Skapa sammanfattning av mötet' — either the compound or that phrasing is fine; keep one per surface.
